mechanism.claim: During elevated completed realized variation, a daily BTC close in the bottom or top fifth of its own completed high-low range is an Internal Bar Strength extreme. Fade the one-day closing-location displacement for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when IBS<=0.20; short when IBS>=0.80
mechanism.why_distinct: IBS is the completed daily candle's own close location with no trailing price envelope. The prior range-boundary fade used a rolling twelve-hour range, six fixed four-hour clocks, 0.10/0.90 edges, two-hour holds, and a top-20% range-rank gate. This policy reuses no event set or control and uses no volume, flow, OI, funding, or fitted outcome.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: daily closing-location overshoot is admitted only when completed twenty-day close-to-close realized variation ranks in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse daily own-range closing-location extremes are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every calendar day at exact 00:00 UTC
features.daily_bar: exact aggregation of 1,440 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-24h,D)
features.ibs: (daily close-daily low)/(daily high-daily low), strict positive range required by this policy
features.event: IBS<=.20 gives long, IBS>=.80 gives short; middle values no event
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared latest twenty completed daily close-to-close log returns), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier source-valid daily decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: daily aggregation, variation window, and rank history reset after any invalid completed day

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical daily IBS symmetric extreme reversal under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no bar, extreme levels, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Internal Bar Strength; QuantConnect LEAN canonical implementation and conventional 20/80 extreme interpretation
external_basis.fixed_definition: IBS=(close-low)/(high-low); exact zero range returns .5; LEAN states low values are bullish and high values bearish; conventional bottom/top fifth extremes are fixed at .20/.80
external_basis.selection_use: official formula and direction plus conventional symmetric 20/80 extreme levels only; no incidence or outcomes
